nodes.label: Keep the project out of iCloud (.venv.nosync + .venv symlink)
nodes.norm_label: keep the project out of icloud (.venv.nosync + .venv symlink)
nodes.rationale: On macOS the Desktop and Documents folders may sync with iCloud, which badly slows reading the thousands of venv files so tests and startup hang. Clone to a normal folder such as ~/dev/LexHack, or name the venv .venv.nosync and symlink .venv to it (as done in backend/); the .nosync suffix tells iCloud not to sync.
